contract.preserved_authority_code: Adapter must not invoke worker publication/physics for a human.
contract.server_graph_loader: Original loading algorithm retained. Adapter must supply the client navgraph cache or override only the graph I/O seam.
contract.shared_trigger: burst_mechanics remains the common manual/Bot physical trigger owner.

extractions.contract: Every seed, self-method dependency, and referenced global helper is copied verbatim except explicit imports. No original-owner Bot method delegation.
Only WORKER_AUTHORITY_ID, SNAPSHOT_STALL_SECONDS, _exact_int and integer_types are required. All source fragments are byte-for-byte; no network owner or original Bot import.
